name: Hindi
romanizationNotes: All Hindi text is shown in romanized form (Latin script). Long vowels are doubled: aa, ii, uu. Aspirated consonants use 'h' after the base letter: kh, gh, ch, jh, th, dh, ph, bh. Retroflex sounds are written the same as dental (t/d) for simplicity. 'sh' represents the श sound while 's' represents स. Nasalized vowels are not specially marked unless critical for meaning.
